questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: Why solar power is more expensive than fossil fuels
Unusual projects that put solar panels in new places
How ancient people used the sun in war
Why electric cars are becoming cheaper
questions.why: Beth says they'll explore two surprising solar projects to build panels in weird and wonderful places.

questions.q: What problem with solar panels do the presenters describe?
options: They don't work well in cold, cloudy countries
They are too heavy for most houses' roofs
Rooftop space for them is running out
People think they look ugly on old houses
questions.why: Beth says as rooftops fill up with solar panels, finding space for them becomes difficult.

questions.q: What does Joshua Pearce want Walmart to do?
options: Put solar-panel covers over all its car parks
Sell solar panels to its customers
Build solar farms outside cities
Stop customers driving to its shops
questions.why: He wants Walmart to introduce solar canopies in all their car parks.

questions.q: How could the solar canopies help drivers?
options: They would make parking free
They would reduce the price of petrol
They would help drivers find parking spaces
They would let drivers charge electric cars for free
questions.why: The electricity can be given to customers to charge their electric cars for free.

questions.q: What does Joshua Pearce expect to happen soon?
options: A huge increase in projects like this
Walmart will reject the idea
Electric cars will become less popular
The cost of solar panels will rise
questions.why: He says in the very near future we're going to see an enormous increase.

questions.q: Why would solar panels in space produce more electricity?
options: The sun is much closer there
There is no night and no change of seasons
The panels are much bigger than on Earth
There is no dust to cover them
questions.why: Neil says with no night or changing seasons, space panels would generate 13 times as much electricity.

questions.q: According to Martin Soltau, why is space solar possible only now?
options: NASA has finally started building it in orbit
Scientists only recently came up with the idea
Sending things into space is much cheaper
Governments have agreed to pay for all of it
questions.why: He says the cost of getting things into space has tumbled by over 90%.

questions.q: What does Neil mean by saying 'a good idea is a good idea'?
options: Only brand-new ideas are worth paying for
Space solar is a bad idea that won't work
Most solar projects fail after a few years
Sun power works, in ancient times or the future
questions.why: He says a good idea is a good idea 'whether it's thousands of years ago or in the near future'.
